title: Jopolo Moruru
author: Traditional
content:
{title: Jopolo Moruru}

{comment: Verse 1}
Jopolo moruru,pakuru, Yesu gi chunyu duto,
Jachien omiye duong` , ong`eyo Yesu Olongo nyinge.

Paulo ong`eyo Yesu ang`eyo,
Uluongo nyinge unie ng`a-gi gini
Uluongo nyinge unie ng`a-gi gini

{comment: Verse 2}
Ji duto mantie piny, pakuru Yesu gi chunyu duto,
Yembe manie piny gi luoro Yesu gi winjo duonde
Yembe manie piny gi luoro Yesu gi winjo duonde

{comment: Verse 3}
Jondongomanie piny, pakuru Yesu gi chunyu duto.
Yembe manie piny gi luoro Yesu gi winjo duonde
Yembe manie piny gi luoro Yesu gi winjo duonde

{comment: Verse 4}
Nyithindo manie piny, ng`euru Yesu ubed joge.
Ohero ji duto kata nyithindo gi jomadongo
Ohero ji duto kata nyithindo gi jomadongo

{comment: Verse 5}
Jogo modak epiny, urit chick Yesu malong`o.
Tho duto manie piny,giringo Yesu dwaro konyruok
Tho duto manie piny,giringo Yesu dwaro konyruok

{comment: Verse 6}
Un joma oyie duto, timuru teko uchop tichne.
Jochiende manie piny gi ringo Yesu gi dhi e nam
Jochiende manie piny gi ringo Yesu gi dhi e nam
